why: One log by id. The caller's membership is part of the lookup, so a log of another workspace answers exactly as a log that is not there — 404 either way. It was an existence oracle on both tiers until 2026-11-08 (403 for a row that exists, 404 for one that does not), which is why both answers are asked for here.
